candidates.title: Invite-only Cybercab orders open at $29,990 for December Austin delivery
candidates.whyItMightMatter: First personal Cybercab sales, still invite-only, with a mandatory $299 autonomy subscription and a $1,000 deposit

candidates.title: Cybercab will not drive without a paid subscription and is barred from commercial use
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Contract locks the car to Robotaxi geofences, bans ride-hail without Tesla's OK, and Musk already calls the $299 fee too high versus about $115

candidates.title: Unsupervised Robotaxi opens in San Antonio on Model Y, Cybercab stays Austin-only
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Eighth unsupervised city and a roughly 275-square-mile day-one zone, Tesla's fifth Texas market after Fort Worth

candidates.title: Austin Robotaxi service area jumps about 62% to roughly 442 square miles
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Tesla confirmed a larger paid Austin map the same day earlier out-of-geofence Cybercab sightings had been only cameras

candidates.title: Robotaxi hours go 24/7 in every city Tesla already serves
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Closes the overnight gap ahead of the year-end target, without adding cities or highway access

candidates.title: Texas registry lists 1,302 Tesla Robotaxis, including 573 Cybercabs, just ahead of Waymo
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Nov. 10 TxDMV count is 729 Model Ys plus 573 Cybercabs versus Waymo's 1,297, and registrations are not active riders

candidates.title: Finland becomes the 11th EU country to approve supervised FSD
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Tesla Europe says rollout begins soon, with no date or version, and it is still assisted driving rather than EU-wide approval

candidates.title: 2026.39.100 ships Europe's 10% speed cap under the Tesla Assisted Driving name
candidates.whyItMightMatter: FSD v14.2.2.6 actually installs the RDW cap and resets offset to zero, while notes claim it is only a rename, ahead of December's EU vote

candidates.title: Giga Berlin targets mid-2027 for full 4680 cell production
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Plant director says electrodes still ship to Texas for cells; he also put Model Y output at 7,500 a week

candidates.title: U.S. order page drops the $41,990 Model Y AWD and stretches Premium deliveries into 2027
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Cheapest AWD path is gone; Premium shows January-March 2027 and Model Y L shows February-April 2027 in a Seattle check

candidates.title: Musk extends Cybertruck production through the end of summer 2027
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Pushes the wind-down past the earlier mid-2027 line so more backlog can be built, while only Cyberbeast remains orderable

candidates.title: Musk says many Cybertruck deposits will be refunded because orders outrun the line
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Order rate still exceeds production, so a lot of buyers will not get a truck before the line is torn down for Cybercab

candidates.title: U.S. Cybertruck orders collapse to a $109,990 Cyberbeast
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Premium AWD and dual-motor orders are disabled and Cyberbeast is up $7,500 from $102,490 earlier the same day

candidates.title: Tesla says Chicago's first 50 Semis are en route
candidates.whyItMightMatter: A numbered customer shipment, not a confirmed handoff, a day after six Megacharger stalls were announced in Hodgkins

candidates.title: Bloomberg says a Tesla-SpaceX merger could be announced in December
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Boards are on terms and governance; China operations versus SpaceX defense work is the open hurdle, and Terafab is cited as shared work
